# Configuration examples

## Summary

An overview containing different configuration examples.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples.md

---

An overview containing different configuration examples.

This section contains examples for how to configure n8n to solve particular use cases.

## In this section

* [Isolate n8n](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/isolate-n8n): prevent your n8n instance from connecting with n8n's servers.
* [Configure the Base URL](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/configure-the-base-url): define the front end's access path to the back end's REST API.
* [Configure custom SSL certificate authorities](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/configure-custom-ssl-certificate-authorities): work with self-signed certificates when connecting to services.
* [Set a custom encryption key](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/set-a-custom-encryption-key): set a custom encryption key to securely encrypt credentials.
* [Configure workflow timeouts](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/configure-workflow-timeouts): set execution timeouts to determine how long workflows can run.
* [Specify custom nodes location](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/specify-custom-nodes-location): add folders and specify paths for your custom nodes.
* [Enable modules in Code node](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/enable-modules-in-code-node): allow the use of built-in and external modules in the Code node.
* [Set the timezone](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/set-the-timezone): change the default timezone for your self-hosted instance.
* [Specify user folder path](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/specify-user-folder-path): specify the location of the folder that stores user-specific data.
* [Configure webhook URLs with reverse proxy](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/configure-webhook-urls-with-reverse-proxy): customize webhook URLs for compatibility with reverse proxy setups.
* [Enable Prometheus metrics](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/enable-prometheus-metrics): enable the Prometheus metrics endpoint.
* [Pre-configure Microsoft OAuth credentials](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/pre-configure-microsoft-oauth-credentials): let users connect without their own app registration.
* [Configure a custom workflow templates library](/deploy/host-n8n/configure-n8n/basic-configuration/configuration-examples/configure-a-custom-workflow-templates-library): set up a custom workflow template library.
